```plato
//==
// # Higher dimensions
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Higher dimensions
//  - Escape-time fractal parameters

//==
// # Higher dimensions
//
// Dimension-generic (N-dimensional) structures over PointN/VectorN: spheres,
// hyperplanes, simplices, and affine subspaces. The arity of the stored points
// and vectors sets the dimension. All distances are unit-agnostic world units.
// (Fixed 4D geometry — points, rotors, polytopes — was removed 2026-07-28:
// the practical 4D uses are numeric and live on Number4/Quaternion.)

// The set of points at distance Radius (world units) from Center in
// N-dimensional space, where N is the arity of Center.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N-sphere)
type NSphere
    implements IValue
{
    Center: PointN;
    Radius: Number;
}
```
